title: DX11 SetFragmentSampler must be implemented — not a no-op
content: IRHICommandList::SetFragmentSampler() had a default no-op implementation. DX11 never overrode it. Text/font renderers that call SetFragmentSampler(0, m_fontSampler) to bind the font atlas sampler had no sampler bound on DX11 — font atlas sampled with default sampler state producing garbled or invisible text. Fix: implement DX11 override using PSSetSamplers/CSSetSamplers (routes to CS stage when m_computePipelineBound). Always check that all IRHICommandList virtual methods have real implementations on every backend.
